description: Java class AclValidator for validating AccessControlList objects with minimum permissions, including methods for validation and reason retrieval.

classes.name: AclValidator
classes.description: Final class implementing Validator to validate AccessControlList objects against required permissions.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Factory method to create a new AclValidator instance with specified ACL and permissions.

methods.name: isValid
methods.description: Performs validation of the ACL, checking for emptiness, single entry validity, and presence of authorized subjects with required permissions.

methods.name: getReason
methods.description: Returns an optional string explaining the reason for validation failure, if any.
